# Blob Morph

**Morph › Object** · v1.0.0 · 48 frames at 30 fps (24–90)

The frame collapses into a wobbling liquid blob, which turns into the new scene and swells back to fill the frame.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/blob-morph@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Organic, playful brands
- Kids and lifestyle content
- Liquid themes

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import blobMorph from './transitions/07-morph/object/blob-morph';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(blobMorph, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 48 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `background` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | Colour that closes in around the shrinking frame; use the incoming scene's background colour. |
| `wobble` | number | `0.18` | 0–0.4 | How much the blob wobbles. |
| `seed` | integer | `1` | 0–9999 | Changes the random layout. |
